outcome: proportion of women achieving spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent labor induction at referral hospitals in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, between April and May 2021.
finding: Oxytocin was identified as the most effective and safest method for labor induction within 24 hours, leading to favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to dinoprostone, misoprostol, and balloon catheter.
mod_finding: Oxytocin induction resulted in the highest rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery (95%), and factors like multigravidity, comorbidities, and oxytocin use were positively associated with achieving SVD.
gest_age: 61.5% of the pregnancies were at term.
